source: infra/lib (the CDK stacks: service-stack.ts, data-stack.ts, auth-stack.ts, edge-stack.ts) and README.md
note: How AWS City itself runs when it's hosted (npm run setup): its published defaults, not anyone's private config. The only prices are Fargate's, worked out from the task sizes here and FARGATE_ARM_PRICE; infra/test/city-architecture.test.ts checks both against the synthesized stacks. Everything else is pay per use, and the idle total is the README's own estimate.

price.source: AWS Price List API, Nov 2026 (infra/lib/models.ts FARGATE_ARM_PRICE)

components.name: The AWS City extension
components.simple: The city you play in, in your browser.

components.name: AWS WAF
components.simple: Turns away bad traffic before it reaches the city.

components.name: Amazon CloudFront
components.simple: The front door: one safe address for every player.

components.name: Load balancer
components.simple: Shares players between the servers. Private: only CloudFront reaches it.

components.name: Amazon Cognito
components.simple: Sign-in, and a code from your phone before any change.

components.name: AWS City server
components.simple: Runs the agents, the city's rules and your approvals.

components.name: Amazon CloudWatch
components.simple: Logs, alarms, and a line for every change to your account.

components.name: Amazon DynamoDB
components.simple: Every player's progress and linked account.

components.name: Amazon S3
components.simple: Uploads, and the template that links your account.

components.name: AWS KMS
components.simple: The keys that lock the city's data.

components.name: AWS Backup
components.simple: A copy of the progress table, every day.

components.name: Amazon Bedrock
components.simple: Amazon Nova or Claude, once the account's Bedrock answers.

components.name: The city's own AI (Qwen3 4B)
components.simple: An open model on Fargate, while Bedrock is held. Only the server can reach it.
components.optional: Only while it's switched on (npm run ai).

components.name: AWS Knowledge
components.simple: Read-only AWS docs the agents quote.

components.name: AWS status and news
components.simple: AWS's public Health Dashboard and What's New.

components.name: Your AWS account
components.simple: Reached through your AWS City role, and every change waits for your Approve.
